title: Full Time task card
description: One build or production job for Codex or a fresh Claude session (docs/ENGINE-V2.md, section 6). Saved as tasks/<card_id>.json, at most 6 KB as canonical JSON. This file describes the shape for people and tooling; engine/dispatch.py validate_card() is the enforcement and also refuses what JSON Schema cannot say well: a worktree that is not ../growth-fulltime-wt/<card_id>, a write_allow glob that would match anything under .git, duplicate paths, and a card over 6 KB. guard() then refuses a Codex card when the allowance reading is unknown, more than one hour old, in the future or above 80%, unless Krish's spend decision names the card.

card_id.description: Also the file name: tasks/<card_id>.json, with its prompt in tasks/<card_id>.md.

kind.description: build runs in its own worktree; production runs in the main checkout with --require-existing-history.

model.description: Pinned, never inherited. A Codex card names exactly gpt-6.1-sol; gpt-6-astra burns the shared allowance 2 to 2.6 times faster.

effort.description: Pinned; medium unless the card says why.

worktree.description: Required for build, exactly ../growth-fulltime-wt/<card_id>. Forbidden for production.

goal.description: Optional: what the card is for and how it is staged, in plain words.

write_allow.description: Repo-relative fnmatch globs the card may write. Never absolute, never .., never .git, never the single pattern **.

read_files.description: At most five repo-relative files the card reads, named one by one.

never.description: What the card never does. These six are always present; more may be added.

acceptance.description: Shell commands, run from the repository root, that all exit 0 when the card is done. Claude reruns them outside the sandbox; the executor's report is never evidence.

return_shape.description: Each field of the answer and what it holds.
